def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci,cj=(h-1)/2,(w-1)/2
    ones=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==1]
    for (i,j) in ones:
        di = 1 if i<ci else -1
        dj = 1 if j<cj else -1
        ci_,cj_=i,j
        while True:
            ni,nj=ci_+di,cj_+dj
            if not(0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w): break
            if g[ni][nj]==6:
                # bounce: flip dj, draw 6-ray from the 6
                dj=-dj
                a,b=ni,nj
                while True:
                    a+=di; b+=dj
                    if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w): break
                    if g[a][b]!=bg: break
                    g[a][b]=6
                break
            if g[ni][nj]!=bg: break  # another 1 or other seed
            if not(0<=ni+di<h and 0<=nj+dj<w): break  # stop one before exit; don't fill
            g[ni][nj]=1
            ci_,cj_=ni,nj
    return g

for k,p in enumerate(pairs):
    ok = transform([r[:] for r in p["input"]])==p["output"]
    print("demo",k+1,ok)

def transform_seq(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci,cj=(h-1)/2,(w-1)/2
    emis=[]
    for (i,j) in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==1]:
        di=1 if i<ci else -1
        dj=1 if j<cj else -1
        a,b=i,j
        while True:
            a,b=a+di,b+dj
            if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w): break
            v=g[a][b]
            if v==6:
                emis.append((a,b,di,-dj)); continue
            if v!=bg: break
            if not(0<=a+di<h and 0<=b+dj<w): break
            g[a][b]=1
    for (a,b,di,dj) in emis:
        for s in (1,-1):
            x,y=a,b
            while True:
                x,y=x+s*di,y+s*dj
                if not(0<=x<h and 0<=y<w): break
                if g[x][y]==bg: g[x][y]=6
    return g

ok=[transform_seq([r[:] for r in p["input"]])==p["output"] for p in pairs]
print(ok)
if all(ok):
    print(json.dumps({"action":"submit","grid":transform_seq([r[:] for r in test])}))

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci,cj=(h-1)/2,(w-1)/2
    def emit(a,b,di,dj):
        for s in (1,-1):
            x,y=a,b
            while True:
                x,y=x+s*di,y+s*dj
                if not(0<=x<h and 0<=y<w): break
                if g[x][y]!=bg: break
                g[x][y]=6
    for (i,j) in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==1]:
        di=1 if i<ci else -1
        dj=1 if j<cj else -1
        a,b=i,j
        mine={(i,j)}
        while True:
            a,b=a+di,b+dj
            if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w): break
            cnt=sum(1 for y,x in [(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                    if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and g[y][x]!=bg and (y,x) not in mine)
            if cnt>=2: break
            v=g[a][b]
            if v==6:
                emit(a,b,di,-dj)
                mine.add((a,b))
                continue
            if v!=bg: break
            if not(0<=a+di<h and 0<=b+dj<w): break
            g[a][b]=1; mine.add((a,b))
    return g

print([transform([r[:] for r in p["input"]])==p["output"] for p in pairs])

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci,cj=(h-1)/2,(w-1)/2
    sixes=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==6]
    d6=set()
    for i,j in sixes: d6.add((0,i-j)); d6.add((1,i+j))  # 0:main,1:anti
    def emit(a,b,di,dj):
        for s in (1,-1):
            x,y=a,b
            while True:
                x,y=x+s*di,y+s*dj
                if not(0<=x<h and 0<=y<w): break
                if g[x][y]!=bg: break
                g[x][y]=6
    for (i,j) in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==1]:
        di=1 if i<ci else -1; dj=1 if j<cj else -1
        main = (di==dj); c0=(i-j) if main else (i+j)
        a,b=i,j
        while True:
            a,b=a+di,b+dj
            if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w): break
            v=g[a][b]
            if v==6:
                # original 6 on own line -> pass & emit; emitted 6 -> stop before? handled below
                if (0 if main else 1, (a-b) if main else (a+b))==((0 if main else 1),c0):
                    emit(a,b,di,-dj); continue
                break
            if v!=bg: break  # another 1
            # foreign 6-diagonal check on either diagonal of this cell
            t1=(0,a-b); t2=(1,a+b)
            foreign = any(t in d6 and t[1]!=c0 for t in (t1 if main else t2, t2 if main else t1) )
            # own-line tag: the cell's own-line diagonal must not count as foreign
            own_t=(0 if main else 1, c0)
            foreign = any(t in d6 and t!=own_t for t in (t1,t2))
            if foreign: break
            if not(0<=a+di<h and 0<=b+dj<w): break
            g[a][b]=1
    return g

# candidate fix: emitted 6-cells are passed through silently; only original foreign 6-diagonals block
def transform2(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci,cj=(h-1)/2,(w-1)/2
    sixes=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==6]
    d6={(0,i-j) for i,j in sixes}|{(1,i+j) for i,j in sixes}
    def emit(a,b,di,dj):
        for s in (1,-1):
            x,y=a+s*di,b+s*dj
            while 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==bg:
                g[x][y]=6; x+=s*di; y+=s*dj
    for (i,j) in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==1]:
        di=1 if i<ci else -1; dj=1 if j<cj else -1
        main=(di==dj); own=(0 if main else 1, (i-j) if main else (i+j))
        a,b=i,j
        while True:
            a,b=a+di,b+dj
            if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w): break
            v=g[a][b]
            if v==6:
                t=(0 if main else 1,(a-b) if main else (a+b))
                if t==own: emit(a,b,di,-dj); continue
                break
            if v!=bg: break
            t1,t2=(0,a-b),(1,a+b)
            if any(t in d6 and t!=own for t in (t1,t2)): break
            if not(0<=a+di<h and 0<=b+dj<w): break
            g[a][b]=1
    return g

def transform3(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci,cj=(h-1)/2,(w-1)/2
    orig6={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==6}
    d6={(0,i-j) for i,j in orig6}|{(1,i+j) for i,j in orig6}
    def emit(a,b,di,dj):
        for s in (1,-1):
            x,y=a+s*di,b+s*dj
            while 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==bg:
                g[x][y]=6; x+=s*di; y+=s*dj
    for (i,j) in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==1]:
        di=1 if i<ci else -1; dj=1 if j<cj else -1
        main=(di==dj); c0=(i-j) if main else (i+j)
        a,b=i,j
        while True:
            a,b=a+di,b+dj
            if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w): break
            v=g[a][b]
            if v!=bg:  # 1, original 6, or emitted 6
                if v==6 and (a,b) in orig6 and (a-b==c0 if main else a+b==c0):
                    emit(a,b,di,-dj); continue
                break
            t1,t2=(0,a-b),(1,a+b)
            own=(0,c0) if main else (1,c0)
            if any(t in d6 and t!=own for t in (t1,t2)): break
            if not(0<=a+di<h and 0<=b+dj<w): break
            g[a][b]=1
    return g
